# proxmox_node_apt_repository (Resource)

Enables or disables one repository entry of an APT source file through `POST /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories`. The entry itself must already exist. Destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_apt_repository" "enterprise" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  path    = "/etc/apt/sources.list.d/pve-enterprise.sources"
  index   = 0
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the repository is enabled.
- `index` (Number) Zero-based index of the repository inside the file. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node. Changes require replacement.
- `path` (String) Source file path such as `/etc/apt/sources.list`. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<path>/<index>` form.
